request.narration: warm, gentle and full of wonder, like a bedtime story

questionnaire.Where does the story take place?: a rainy seaside town where the gutters run like little rivers down to the harbour
questionnaire.Who is the supporting character?: Biscuit, Maya's scruffy golden puppy with one floppy ear
questionnaire.What challenge does the main character f: Maya's paper boat, carrying a birthday note for her grandmother, races away down the rainy street toward the sea
questionnaire.How do they overcome the challenge?: Maya and Biscuit chase it through puddles, ask a fisherman for help, and catch it just before the harbour; the soggy note still makes Grandma laugh and cry
questionnaire.What lesson does the story teach?: what matters is the love you send, not how perfect it arrives

references.description: 7-year-old girl, curly dark brown hair in two puffs, warm brown skin, yellow raincoat
a small scruffy golden puppy with one floppy ear and a red collar
